data.content_ref: inline:This conjecture reduces the suspended-label semantics to a two-player argument game: a node is accepted in the grounded extension iff the proponent has a winning strategy to defend it, and a node is suspended iff no strategy rebuts the RESIDUE-named attacker; the diagnostic overlay (SRC_002, SRC_003, SRC_005, SRC_009) is then the strategy tree made explicit rather than a graph annotation. REFUTED IF there exists a final grounded labeling where a node is accepted but the proponent has no finite winning strategy, or where RESIDUE names an attacker that the defender can rebut in the game — i.e., if the game semantics and the diagnostic overlay diverge on any admitted graph.
